lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots are arranged in a structured grid of vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, extending across the visible lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary horizontal spot rows, creating a lattice-like pattern across the mid-lateral area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel horizontal ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on the superior edge to shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, circular, reddish-brown pigmented lesion or anomaly is visible on the mid-lateral flank, anterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
other_distinctive_markers: Several associated teleost fish (remoras) are visible in the ventral water column directly beneath the pectoral fin and abdomen.
